label: Slayer Task
title: Slayer task
body: Target counts as your Slayer task: enables on-task bonuses (Slayer helmet/Black mask, enhanced Magic Dart)

label: In Wilderness
title: In Wilderness
body: Enables Wilderness-only weapon bonuses (Craw's bow, Viggora's chainmace, Thammaron's sceptre and their upgrades)

label: Kandarin Hard Diary
title: Kandarin Hard Diary
body: +10% chance for enchanted bolt special effects to trigger

label: Mark of Darkness
title: Mark of Darkness
body: Arceuus spell: doubles a demonbane spell's accuracy bonus and adds 25% damage vs demons (50% with a Purging staff)

label: Charge Spell
title: Charge spell
body: The Mage Arena god spells (Saradomin Strike, Claws of Guthix, Flames of Zamorak) hit 30 instead of 20 while the MATCHING god cape is worn. Asserts a rune-costing self-buff you keep up — the staff and cape still have to be in the loadout.

label: Sunfire Runes
title: Sunfire runes or searing pages
body: Offensive fire spells deal a minimum of 10% of your max hit on successful casts. Tick this for a tome of fire charged with searing pages too: same 10% minimum, and item names cannot tell the charge states apart. The tome's own +10% damage is excluded from the minimum either way.

label: Require Task Equipment
title: Require task equipment
body: Only suggest loadouts you could actually wear on this Slayer task — earmuffs for banshees, a nose peg for spectres, a mirror shield for basilisks, boots of stone in the Karuulm dungeon. A slayer helmet covers all five head requirements. Turn off to see the unconstrained ceiling.

label: Kourend Elite Diary
title: Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary
body: Completed: the Karuulm dungeon floor no longer burns you, so Wyrm, Drake and Hydra tasks stop spending the boot slot on boots of stone. Nothing else in the Slayer requirement list is waived by a diary.

label: Ignore Level Requirements
title: Ignore level requirements
body: Search gear you cannot yet wear, to see what your levels are costing you. Off by default: unwearable gear is dropped before the search runs, so leaving this off only makes it faster.

label: Require Knockback Weight
title: Require knockback weight
body: Gryphons knock you back and deal damage when your worn equipment is too light; enough weight suppresses the special — 30kg for ordinary gryphons, 40kg for dire and shellbane. Costs a lot of DPS, so it's off by default. No effect on anything that isn't a gryphon.

label: Require Breath Shield
title: Require breath shield
body: Only suggest loadouts that survive the target's dragonfire or icy breath: the shield slot must hold protection, ruling out two-handed weapons. Leave off if you're using an antifire potion, Protect from Magic, or safespotting. No effect on targets that don't breathe.

title: Refresh stats
body: Re-read skill levels from the logged-in account

title: Current HP
body: Dharok's Wretched Strength scales with missing hitpoints

title: Agility
body: No effect on damage — it only gates crystal equipment, which wants 70

title: Combat spell
body: Auto lets the engine pick the best eligible spell per loadout; choose one to force it

title: Soul stacks
body: Banked on a Soulreaper axe — each adds 6% of your base Strength level, up to 5

title: Targets
body: Enemies you are stacking, for area-of-effect weapons. Leave at 1 for ordinary single-target DPS — above 1 the figure becomes total damage across the clump, which will rank chinchompas above single-target weapons.

title: Thrall
body: Adds the thrall's average damage (max hit / 2 every 4 ticks) as flat DPS

title: Max catalytic rune
body: Highest catalytic rune the standard-spellbook auto-picker may spend — e.g. Blood (Wave) keeps Wrath-rune Surge spells out of recommendations

title: Max multi-target spell
body: Highest ancient Burst/Barrage tier the auto-picker may spend runes on. Across a clump a Barrage beats every single-target spell, so cap it if you would not pay for one

title: Special attacks
body:
Ticked (Auto): each loadout adds your best owned spec weapon's DPS, limited by spec regen (a worn Lightbearer doubles it — the search knows).
Unticked: no specs in the model.
Exclude a weapon in the Items tab to keep Auto off it.

title: Kill scenario
body:
Unticked — Continuous: back-to-back kills (slayer, trips); specs limited to natural regen.
Ticked — Isolated kill: one kill arriving with a full spec bar — worth ~5x the spec DPS on a short boss kill. Needs known target HP, else falls back to continuous.

title: Vulnerability
body: Target is under Vulnerability: −10% Defence (ignored if the Accursed sceptre drain is also set)

title: Accursed sceptre
body: Special has landed: −15% Defence and Magic (supersedes Vulnerability)

title: Dragon warhammer
body: Specials LANDED: each drains 30% of the target's current Defence

title: Elder maul
body: Specials landed: each drains 35% of current Defence

title: Arclight / Darklight
body: Specials landed: each drains 5% of base Attack/Strength/Defence (10% on demons) — the two weapons drain at identical rates

title: Emberlight
body: Specials landed: each drains 5% of base Attack/Strength/Defence (15% on demons)

title: Tonalztics of ralos
body: Specials landed: each drains Defence by an eighth of the target's Magic level

title: Bandos godsword
body: Total special DAMAGE dealt — drains Defence one for one, spilling into Strength, Attack, Magic then Ranged only as each stat reaches 0. Bosses with a defence floor (Nex 250, ToA rooms, …) stop the drain there; Verzik and Vardorvis can't be drained at all.

title: Seercull
body: Total special damage dealt: drains Magic one for one

title: Eye of Ayak
body: Magic defence BONUS drained by specials (only while the bonus is positive)

title: Current prayer points
body: The abyssal bludgeon's Penance special gains 0.5% damage per MISSING point, measured against your Prayer level. Refreshing stats seeds this to the full pool for your level.

effect: +3 invisible Magic levels on a powered staff — autocast gains no invisible boost
+3 invisible Defence levels, longer attack range
+1 invisible Magic and +3 Defence on a powered staff, longer attack range
